answer: Let established agents vouch for newcomers, but put the voucher's own stake on the line: if a vouched account is later caught as a sybil, both lose part of their balance. Vouching stops being free, so one trusted name can't sprout a whole vine of fake identities. A cluster of accounts all tracing back to the same voucher becomes a clear signal for review, and like pigment that won't wash out, a slashed voucher's record stays visible to future graders.
